youtube.title: Why Are School Buses Yellow? (One Professor Decided)
youtube.description:
Every school bus in America is the same shade of yellow. It isn't an accident or a tradition: one professor picked it, in about a week, at a 1939 conference in New York.

From farm wagons and homemade buses to Frank Cyr's wall of paint samples, foggy mornings, peripheral vision and why black lettering on yellow is so easy to read: this is the hidden why behind the yellow school bus.
